description: This file defines the GatewaySettingsStore enum as a singleton namespace, containing static methods and properties for managing gateway configuration and credentials, primarily using Keychain and UserDefaults for persistence. It also includes GatewayDiagnostics enum for logging diagnostics to a file. The file handles storing, retrieving, and migrating gateway-related data such as stable IDs, tokens, and last connection info.

classes.name: GatewaySettingsStore
classes.description: Singleton namespace containing static methods for managing gateway settings, credentials, last connection info, and related preferences.

classes.name: GatewayDiagnostics
classes.description: Handles logging diagnostics, including log file management, truncation, and appending logs.

methods.name: bootstrapPersistence
methods.description: Initializes or verifies persistent gateway-related identifiers.

methods.name: loadStableInstanceID
methods.description: Loads the stored stable instance ID from Keychain.

methods.name: saveStableInstanceID
methods.description: Saves the stable instance ID to Keychain.

methods.name: loadPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Loads the preferred gateway stable ID from Keychain.

methods.name: savePreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Saves the preferred gateway stable ID to Keychain.

methods.name: clearPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Removes the preferred gateway stable ID from Keychain and UserDefaults.

methods.name: loadLastDiscoveredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Loads the last discovered gateway stable ID from Keychain.

methods.name: saveLastDiscoveredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Stores the last discovered gateway stable ID.

methods.name: clearLastDiscoveredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Removes the last discovered gateway stable ID from Keychain and UserDefaults.

methods.name: loadGatewayToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored gateway token for a specific instance ID.

methods.name: saveGatewayToken
methods.description: Stores a gateway token for a specific instance ID.

methods.name: loadGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Retrieves the bootstrap token for a specific instance ID.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores the bootstrap token for a specific instance ID.

methods.name: clearGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Deletes bootstrap token for an instance ID.

methods.name: loadGatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the stored gateway password.

methods.name: saveGatewayPassword
methods.description: Stores the gateway password.

methods.name: loadTalkProviderApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves the API key for a specified talk provider.

methods.name: saveTalkProviderApiKey
methods.description: Stores or deletes the API key for a given talk provider.

methods.name: saveLastGatewayConnectionManual
methods.description: Stores the details of a manual last gateway connection.

methods.name: saveLastGatewayConnectionDiscovered
methods.description: Stores details of a discovered last gateway connection.

methods.name: loadLastGatewayConnection
methods.description: Loads the last stored gateway connection info, migrating from legacy UserDefaults if needed.

methods.name: clearLastGatewayConnection
methods.description: Removes stored last gateway connection info and cleans up legacy keys.

methods.name: deleteGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Deletes all stored credentials related to a specific gateway instance ID.

methods.name: loadGatewayClientIdOverride
methods.description: Retrieves a client ID override for a specific gateway identified by stable ID.

methods.name: saveGatewayClientIdOverride
methods.description: Stores or removes a client ID override for a gateway.

methods.name: loadGatewaySelectedAgentId
methods.description: Retrieves the selected agent ID for a given gateway stable ID.

methods.name: saveGatewaySelectedAgentId
methods.description: Saves or removes the selected agent ID for a gateway.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes diagnostics logging system.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with a timestamp, managing log file size.
